# coralogix_saved_funnel (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    coralogix = {
      source = "coralogix/coralogix"
    }
  }
}

data "coralogix_saved_funnel" "example" {
  id = "<id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Funnel ID, a decimal number. Set by the server.

### Read-Only

- `app_name` (String) RUM application the funnel belongs to.
- `breakdown` (Attributes) Breakdown of the funnel by a session dimension. Absent when not set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--breakdown))
- `created_at` (String) When the funnel was created. Set by the server.
- `definition` (Attributes) Mode, conversion window, and steps of the funnel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition))
- `filters` (Attributes Set) Session filters applied to every step. Empty when not set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `name` (String) Display name of the funnel. Does not have to be unique.
- `owner` (String) User who created the funnel. Set by the server. Absent for funnels saved before owners were recorded.
- `time_range` (Attributes) Time range of the funnel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_range))
- `updated_at` (String) When the funnel was last updated, from the API or the Coralogix UI. Set by the server.
- `version` (Number) Version of the funnel. Set by the server: 1 on create, increased by 1 on every update, including updates made in the Coralogix UI.

<a id="nestedatt--breakdown"></a>
### Nested Schema for `breakdown`

Read-Only:

- `field` (String) Session dimension to split by. BREAKDOWN_FIELD_UNSPECIFIED is rejected.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of groups to return, top groups by first step count.


<a id="nestedatt--definition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition`

Read-Only:

- `conversion_window` (String) Maximum time from the first step to the last step, in whole seconds, such as "3600s". A fraction of a second returns 400. Absent means no window.
- `mode` (String) What the funnel counts: users, sessions, or accounts. FUNNEL_MODE_UNSPECIFIED returns 400.
- `steps` (Attributes List) Steps of the funnel, in funnel order. Steps must happen in this order, and other views and actions may happen in between. The same view or action may appear in two steps. At least one is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--steps))

<a id="nestedatt--definition--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.steps`

Read-Only:

- `conditions` (Attributes Set) Conditions of the step, combined with OR. Their order has no meaning. At least one is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--steps--conditions))
- `label` (String) Display label of the step. Empty when not set.
- `step_id` (String) ID of the step, unique within the funnel. A duplicate returns 400. Steps saved in the Coralogix UI read as s1, s2, and so on, by position.

<a id="nestedatt--definition--steps--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.steps.conditions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (Attributes) Matches a user action on an element. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--steps--conditions--action))
- `view` (Attributes) Matches a visit to a page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--steps--conditions--view))

<a id="nestedatt--definition--steps--conditions--action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.steps.conditions.action`

Read-Only:

- `element` (Attributes) Condition on the target element. Requires event: element without event returns 400. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--steps--conditions--action--element))
- `event` (Attributes) Condition on the event name. Absent matches any event. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--steps--conditions--action--event))
- `filters` (Attributes Set) Filters that narrow this action condition only. Empty when not set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--steps--conditions--action--filters))

<a id="nestedatt--definition--steps--conditions--action--element"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.steps.conditions.action.element`

Read-Only:

- `values` (Set of String) Values to match. At least one is required.

<a id="nestedatt--time_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_range`

Read-Only:

- `calendar` (String) Named calendar window, resolved in the viewer's timezone. CALENDAR_WINDOW_UNSPECIFIED is rejected.
- `fixed` (Attributes) Absolute time range between two timestamps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_range--fixed))
- `relative_minutes` (String) Number of minutes back from now.

<a id="nestedatt--time_range--fixed"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_range.fixed`

Read-Only:

- `from_timestamp_ms` (String) Start of the range, in Unix milliseconds. Inclusive: events at exactly this time are in the range.
- `to_timestamp_ms` (String) End of the range, in Unix milliseconds. Exclusive: events at exactly this time are not in the range, so consecutive ranges can share a boundary.
